description: Reads from the local LevelDB cache, which may lag behind Copilot's server if the macOS app hasn't synced recently. For real-time data use --live-reads with `get_transactions_live`. Unified transaction retrieval tool. Supports multiple modes: (1) Filter-based: Use period, date range, category, merchant, amount filters. (2) Single lookup: Provide transaction_id to get one transaction. (3) Text search: Use query for free-text merchant search. (4) Special types: Use transaction_type for foreign, refunds, credits, duplicates, hsa_eligible, tagged. (5) Location-based: Use city or lat/lon with radius_km. (6) Tag filter: Use tag to find transactions with a specific tag. Returns human-readable category names and normalized merchant names.

country.description: Filter by country code (e.g., US, CL)

exclude_deleted.description: Exclude deleted transactions marked by Plaid (default: true)

exclude_split_parents.description: Exclude split-transaction parents (docs with children_transaction_ids). The children already carry the real categorized amounts — returning the parent would double-count the spend. Default: true.

exclude_transfers.description: Exclude transfers between accounts and credit card payments (default: true)

lat.description: Latitude for proximity search (use with lon and radius_km)

lon.description: Longitude for proximity search (use with lat and radius_km)

offset.description: Number of results to skip for pagination (default: 0)

pending.description: Filter by pending status (true for pending only, false for settled only)

period.description: Period shorthand: this_month, last_month, last_7_days, last_30_days, last_90_days, ytd, this_year, last_year

transaction_id.description: Get a single transaction by ID (ignores other filters)

transaction_type.description: Filter by special type: foreign (international), refunds, credits (cashback/rewards), duplicates (potential duplicate transactions), hsa_eligible (medical expenses), tagged (has tags)

name: get_transactions
